input.summary: Add a Company right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice, with refund of prepaid fees and no termination fee, and confirm Contractor has no convenience right while an SOW is outstanding.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only allows convenience termination when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we would be locked into every engagement for its full duration. We have added our standard right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience on 30 days' notice, paying only for Services performed and recovering prepaid fees; if helpful we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: (c) In addition to the foregoing, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Contractor, without any termination fee, penalty or other charge. Upon such termination, Company shall pay Contractor for Services properly performed through the effective date of termination, and Contractor shall refund to Company any prepaid fees for Services not performed as of that date. Contractor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience while any Statement of Work remains uncompleted.
